validateFileName(persona, fieldName, suite): Clean unification. Three call sites are in mutually-exclusive branches (numbered/standalone/vs_file_name) — no redundant validation. The 7th test case ('includes the fieldName in the error message') correctly captures the new explicit contract of the unified function.
extractMcpServers() Set deduplication: Correct implementation. ES2015+ Set preserves insertion order, which ensures stable YAML output across repeated builds.
Fenced-block stripping regex /```[\s\S]*?```/g: Non-greedy and uses [\s\S] for multiline safety — correct approach without requiring the 's' (dotall) flag.
